RURAL DEVELOPMENT CHARTER NO 15 OF 2017 OF SABARAGAMUWA PROVINCIAL
COUNCIL
Ministry of Social Welfare, Probation and Child Care Rural Development and Rural
Industries

A charter for laying regulations for registration and supervision of rural development organizations,training of community leadership and conducting training centers, establishment of rural zones,establishment of rural authority, establishment of district and provincial authority of SabaragamuwaProvince and the consequential factors in connection with it.
Be it therefore enacted by Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic ofSri Lanka as follows:
Sabaragamuwa Provincial Rural Development Charter No 5 of 2006 shall be repel and abrogate withthe enactment of this Charter.
1. This Charter may be cited as the Rural Development Charter No. 15 of 2017 of Sabaragamuwa Provincial
Council and the effective date shall be the date on which the Provincial Governer approves the charter bysetting his seal.
2. To establish, register, conduct and supervise the Rural Development Societies for economic, social,
cultural, educational and spiritual development with the participation of the public within the authoritativearea of the Provincial Council.
a)Allow the community to be empowered themselves.
b)Training community leaderships.
c)To brighten the socio - economic condition of the rural women by displaying theirinborn skills through women development centers
d)Making the rural youths changing actors for introduction and establishment of new developmentrules and regulations.
e)To direct the societies to monitor the societies according to participatory development approachand making aware on the development rules and regulations of the Provincial Council.
f)To empower the rural development societies to build a pious society.
g)To development the dignity of the Rural Development Societies by holding performancecompetitions.

h)As a whole guidance for the development of vocational skills of the community under the authorityof rural development organization, to provide vocational trainings and to engage in self -employments.
3.a)Secretary of the Ministry of Rural development shall be the chief authority on this Charter.

b)A Director from Sri Lanka Administrative Service class II for the assistance of the Secretary of theMinistry and an Assistant Director for two districts on the seniority of Rural DevelopmentOfficers' Service shall be appointed.

c)Two Rural Development Officers shall be appointed for Rathnapura and Kegalle two districts onthe seniority for the assistance to Director of Rural Development and a Head Quarters ruraldevelopment Officer shall be appointed for preparation of projects in the province, monitoringand evaluation.
RuralDevelopmentCharter No 5 of2006 shall berepel andabrogate

d)Rural Development Officers shall be appointed in order to assist District Officers, for each DivisionalSecretary's Division.
e)Sewing Instructors shall be appointed for conducting women development centers coveringevery divisional secretary's division.
4.a)All the Rural Development Societies shall be Reregistered in Provincial Ministry of RuralDevelopment with the reformations within 3 months since the day this charter comes in to effect.
b)Establishment and registration of new Rural Development Societies shall be done under the rulesof new minute and regulations since the effective date of this Charter.
c)Minutes applicable to Rural Development Societies shall be approved by the Secretary of theMinistry of Rural development.
d)One Rural Development Committe shall be established for each Divisional Secretary's Division.
e)Two Committees shall be established for Rathnapura district and for Kegalle district.
f)Provincial committee shall be established for the province.
g)Separate funds and accounts shall be maintained for each Divisional Committee and ProvincialCommittee.
h)Funds of Divisional Committee and provincial committee shall be made subject to the minute ofthat Committee.
5.A) One fund shall be maintained for Sabaragamuwa Province.
The funds shall be consisting of following sources.

I)Allocations of the annual budget of the Provincial Council.II)Foreign grants given by the government.III)Donations made by the institutions or person.IV)The money charged by the income earned by Rural Development Societies from Constructioncontracts.V)Money earned by Lotteries, shows and other approved ways.VI)Membership fees, money received by the Performance Competition achievements andspecial donations.
B) A committee for the fund consists of 07 persons shall be appointed by the Subject Minister for
this task. As the members of the committee.

I)Secretary of the MinistryII)Provincial Director of Rural DevelopmentIII)Five persons shall be appointed, two on the recommendation of Subject Minister of theRural Development and three on the recommendations of the Financial Minister and thecabinet (This five shall be public officials or educated persons about the subject)IV)The Secretary of the Rural Development Ministry shall be the Chairman of the committeeon the official capacity.
C) The quorum at least shall be three
D) This fund shall be subject to the audit under section 154 of the Constitution.

6.A) To assist for implementation of community leadership development programme.
B) To appraise Projects done productively with community participation, Organizations and
community leaders each year in Divisional, District and Provincial level and gift them withmonitory gifts or ceremonials.
C) To assist, implement and introduce the fields of assistance to timely development.
D) To introduce and assist for the implementation of productivity projects for the economical,
religious, social and good conduct development.
7.A) Solutions and decisions on the disputes of the Rural Development Societies shall be made by the
Secretary in charge of the subject.
B) A person or organization that unsatisfied with the decision may appeal to the Subject Minister.
Final decision on the dispute shall be on the consent of the Subject Minister.
8. Orders for the related tasks of this Charter shall be enacted by the Minister and the approval shall be
grant by the Provincial Council.
9.A) Title of all the buildings built by Provincial Council Fund shall be to Sabaragamuwa Provincial
Council and only the guardianship shall be to the registered Rual Development societies.
B) Title of other stable and unstable properties of Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council is belong to
Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council and guardianship shall be to relevant Rural Development Society.
C) Prior approval shall be obtained by the Secretary of the Ministry in any task such as break and
remove, new construction or changing the structure in any property belong to Rural DevelopmentSocieties.
D) A property of Rural Development Societies may allow for a work out of Rural Development
Societies, Charging or not shall be decided on a decision of general meeting.
10. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Charter, the Sinhala text
shall prevail.
